daily.today_energy: Mercury's got you feeling chatty and curious today. There's a restless vibe in your bones—lean into it. This is your moment to start that conversation you've been sitting on or pitch an idea that's been living rent-free in your head.
daily.love: If you're partnered, your person might need some extra presence today. If you're single, someone's noticing your energy shift. Either way, authenticity is your biggest flex right now. Don't perform; just be.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different today. This is solid energy for brainstorming, networking, or showing up differently in a space where you usually fade back. Trust your instincts—they're sharper than usual.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement, not meditation right now. Go for a walk, dance it out, do something that gets your blood moving. Your nervous system will thank you for channeling this kinetic energy productively.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about reclaiming your narrative. Mars is backing you up, so trust your instincts when they whisper something bold. Something's shifting beneath the surface—pay attention to what your gut's been trying to tell you.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, this is your moment to show up authentically. If there's been tension, vulnerability might be the answer. If you're exploring, someone interesting could appear when you stop looking so hard.
weekly.career: Your creative ideas are hitting different right now. Don't sleep on that project or pitch you've been sitting on. This week favors putting yourself out there—the universe has your back, even if it feels slightly terrifying.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for movement and release. Whether that's a run, a dance session, or just shaking it out, honor that restless energy. Your nervous system needs grounding—maybe some meditation or time outside would hit the spot.
